title: Peeto sar ahle aza ghar se janaza chala sughra
body:
Peeto sar ahle aza ghar se janaza chala, Fatima bimaar ka ghar se janaza chala.
Kehti hai binte Ali Fatima Sughra meri, Hai phuphi tum par fida ghar se janaza chala.
Baap ki shaida utho Fatima Sughra utho, Tumpe yeh madar nisar ghar se janaza chala.
Das hi baras ka tha sin marne ke na the yeh din, Bhai ka pehlu mila ghar se janaza chala…
